label: Black Dragon
description: a fierce kung-fu master called the Black Dragon: long black hair tied in a high topknot with loose strands, a short black goatee, a sleeveless black kung-fu jacket with gold frog buttons and a coiling gold dragon embroidered on it, a red sash belt, loose black trousers, black kung-fu shoes, black leather wrist guards

portrait.prompt: Now something different: NOT a sprite sheet. Draw ONE single square character-select portrait (one image, no grid, no frames) of the same character ({description}), in the same pixel-art style but more detailed: chest-up close-up, the face large with a cold, confident stare, one hand formed into a dragon claw beside the face with wisps of black smoke and a gold glow, the head turned three-quarters toward the right, dramatic rim lighting. Solid dark charcoal with a faint gold glow background with a subtle pixel texture, no other characters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no frame.

actions.label: Idle
actions.note: A low, coiled dragon-style kung-fu fighting stance. The feet stay in the same place in every frame; only the body bobs and breathes.
poses: rest pose in the guard stance
body dips about 2 pixels, shoulders relax
returning to the rest pose, very close to frame 1 so the loop is seamless

actions.label: Walk Forward
actions.note: A guarded step toward the RIGHT. The character stays centred in its cell (walking in place).
poses: contact: front (right) foot stepping forward, guard up
down: weight shifts, knees bend, body dips slightly
passing: the free leg moves past the planted leg
passing, opposite leg, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Walk Backward
actions.note: A retreating step: still FACING RIGHT toward the enemy, guard up, stepping backward (to the left). The character stays centred in its cell.
poses: contact: back (left) foot placed behind, guard up
down: weight shifts, knees bend, body dips slightly
passing: the free leg moves past the planted leg
passing, opposite leg, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Crouch
actions.note: Six clearly DIFFERENT poses going from standing down to kneeling; the feet stay on the same ground line.
poses: standing guard stance exactly as in the reference, full height
half squat, knees bent, head clearly lower than in frame 1
dropping to one knee, the back knee almost touching the ground
kneeling on one knee, guard up, body only about 60 percent as tall as in frame 1

actions.label: Jump
actions.note: The ground line is at the same height in every frame. Frames 1 and 6 have the feet on the ground line; in frames 3, 4 and 5 the whole character is drawn clearly above the ground line. Keep the character horizontally centred in its cell.
poses: anticipation: deep crouch, feet on the ground line
launch: legs extending, feet leaving the ground
rising: whole body above the ground line, knees tucked
landing: feet back on the ground line, knees bent absorbing the impact

actions.label: Block High
actions.note: Feet stay planted. The block pose is held from frame 3 onward.
poses: guard stance, starting to raise the guard
both forearms raised with hands in dragon claws in front of the face
block held: both forearms raised with hands in dragon claws in front of the face and chest, body braced

actions.label: Block Low
actions.note: Feet stay on the ground line. Goes from standing to a LOW crouching block held from frame 3 onward.
poses: crouching low, the guard lowering in front of the knees
block held: deep low crouch kneeling on one knee, guarding the shins, body only about 60 percent as tall as in frame 1

actions.label: Hit High
actions.note: Struck in the face from the RIGHT, recoiling backward to the LEFT; feet stay near the ground line.
poses: impact: head snaps back, eyes shut
maximum recoil: torso bent far back, one foot sliding
back in the guard stance with a pained face

actions.label: Dragon Claw
actions.note: A fast clawed-hand swipe toward the RIGHT at face height. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: strike: the dragon claw raking forward to the RIGHT at face height
full extension: the dragon claw raking forward to the RIGHT at face height, a short white impact streak touching it

actions.label: Dragon Tail
actions.note: A spinning low sweep kick along the ground toward the RIGHT, aimed at the shins. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: wind-up, body turning, the attack chambered
strike: the leg sweeping forward to the RIGHT near the ground, a motion arc touching it
full extension: the leg sweeping forward to the RIGHT near the ground

actions.label: Dragon Awakens
actions.note: Powering up in place; feet stay planted. Black smoke swirls around him in the shape of a coiling dragon, with a gold glow on his fists (black and gold only). The aura always touches the body (no separate floating sparks).

actions.label: Dragon's Regret
actions.note: IMPORTANT: NINE frames in a 3x3 grid (3 columns and 3 ROWS). A three-hit combo toward the RIGHT. The strike frames are 3, 5 and 7; frames 4, 6 and 8 are transitions. Black smoke and a gold glow follow the fists (black and gold only). Effects always touch the fighter or weapon.
poses: first hit: a rushing dragon punch trailing black smoke toward the RIGHT
second hit: a rising uppercut with a gold glow toward the RIGHT
third hit, the finisher: a double-palm strike releasing a large black-smoke dragon head with gold eyes toward the RIGHT, a large burst

actions.label: Knockdown
actions.note: Hit from the RIGHT, falling backward to the LEFT, ending lying on the back with the head to the left and the feet to the right. The lying body must fit inside its cell.
poses: hitting the ground on the back, small dust puff touching the body
lying flat, head to the left, feet to the right
